name: d4-payments
description: Take payment through Stripe Payment Links: the owner pastes a link created in their own Stripe dashboard against each item, and the site renders a Buy button that sends the customer to Stripe's hosted checkout. No API keys, no webhooks and no card data ever touch the site. Ships a public /pay page and a <PayButton /> component that can be embedded on a catalog product, a class, or anywhere else.
clientFacingSummary: Sell things and take deposits from your site: money goes straight into your own Stripe account, and you keep control of every price.
